criteria.requirement: Add generated_sources(cls, names=None) under attr.introspection and attrs.introspection. Inspect actual current class/MRO descriptors without invoking properties or methods. Default to methods with existing attrs-generated code filenames; explicit finite unique method names also report custom/missing entries. Return nested read-only metadata generated/status/source/filename/owner, obtaining real generated source through inspect/linecache. If source is absent report unavailable; if a method is replaced report its current custom status, never stale generated source. Do not synthesize a whole class or export closure values; ordinary fields/inspect remain unchanged.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
